'''Koorst''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was taken as an apprentice by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Vril Vrakth]]. He accompanied Vrakth to [[Nizon]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="The First to Strike">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Koorst made his first appearance in 2008 in ''[[The First to Strike]]'', an adventure in the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] campaign. He is set to appear later in the campaign in ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]''.<ref name="The First to Strike" />
